## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `SetupGuide`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `sap-s4hana-api-slspricingconditionrecord`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **SetupGuide**.

## Step 2: Create a communication user

1. <!-- manual: Log in to your SAP S/4HANA Fiori Launchpad with administrator credentials. -->
2. <!-- manual: Search for and open the Maintain Communication Users app. -->
3. Select **New** to create a new communication user.
4. <!-- manual: Enter a User Name (e.g., PRICING_COND_USER) and a Description. -->
5. <!-- manual: Set a secure Password and confirm it. -->
6. Select **Create** to save the communication user.

## Step 3: Create a communication system

1. <!-- manual: Search for and open the Communication Systems app in the SAP Fiori Launchpad. -->
2. Select **New** and enter a **System ID** (e.g., `BALLERINA_PRICING_COND`) and a **System Name**.
3. <!-- manual: Select New and enter a System ID (e.g., BALLERINA_PRICING_COND) and a System Name. -->
4. <!-- manual: Under Technical Data, set the Host Name to the hostname of your client or integration platform. -->
5. Under **Users for Inbound Communication**, select **+** and select the communication user you created in the previous step.
6. Select **Save**.

## Step 4: Create a communication arrangement

1. <!-- manual: Search for and open the Communication Arrangements app in the SAP Fiori Launchpad. -->
2. Select **New** and search for the communication scenario that includes the Condition Record for Pricing in Sales API (**SAP_COM_0294: Pricing Data Integration**).
3. Select the scenario, then select **Create**.
4. <!-- manual: In the arrangement form, set the Communication System to the system you created in the previous step. -->
5. <!-- manual: Under Inbound Communication, confirm the communication user is listed and that Basic Authentication (or OAuth 2.0 if preferred) is selected as the authentication method. -->
6. Select **Save**.

2. <!-- manual: Navigate to the Inbound Services tab. -->
3. <!-- manual: Locate the entry for API_SLSPRICINGCONDITIONRECORD_SRV and note the Service URL. It follows the pattern: -->
